pages.text: Press $(k:puffish_skills.open) and start planning: six skill trees of 28 or 29 nodes, each levelled by its own experience.

$(bold)Opening:$() $(k:puffish_skills.open). The skill menu shows all six trees and how your points are spent.$(br2)$(bold)Point sources:$() kills feed the four combat trees with the experience the mob drops, breaking blocks feeds Gathering and crafting feeds Engineering. Each level is 1 point in that tree, and 40 Heracles quests ($(k:heracles.open_quests)) pay 86 more, each into one tree.

$(bold)Respec:$() there is none. A point you spend stays spent.$(br2)$(bold)Next: browse the six trees in $(l:icraft:skills/skills_overview)the skill tree overview$(/l) before you spend your first point.$()
